title: stelis cobanensis
intro: Stelis cobanensis, commonly known as the Guatemalan orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Stelis cobanensis include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-hyperglycemic, and anti-trypanocidal activities, which may contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as diabetes and parasitic infections. The bioactive constituents of Stelis cobanensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that have been shown to possess antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
